newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Generale maintains KLM as a hold.
newsitem.headline: Generale maintains KLM as a hold.

text.p: Generale Bank said it was maintaining its hold recommendation on KLM Royal Dutch Airlines after the airline's third quarter results.
Generale analyst Ab Barneveld had earlier told Reuters that the third quarter loss was disappointing and that Generale was maintaining a sell recommendation on KLM.
But he later clarified this, saying the recommendation had actually been upgraded to a hold from a sell before the results.
"We are sticking to a hold recommendation. It was in line with our estimates," Barneveld said.
